title: Choose the visual world for Ramani
question: The roll assigned School Sports Day. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: School Sports Day
options.lineage: Kenyan primary-school sports day: house colours, chalked lanes, rosettes, relay batons
options.thesis: Every child belongs to a house; Ramani tells you which one and where it leads.
materials: chalk lane lines on a warm ground
options.viewport: Hero copy on the starting line, six house-colour lanes running behind it, the CTA where the runner stands, a sample rosette result beside it.
options.risk: Sports day can read as competition; houses must never be ranked or scored against each other.

raised.raise: Each quiz part owns one hue and the current leg's segment extends, so the bar shows the whole run's extent.
Career matches are cards whose ruled back lists the subjects that help.
Every result traces back to the child's own answers, quoted on the card.
One focal move per section; everything else stays quiet chalk ground.

options.label: Textbook Cover
options.lineage: Kenyan primary textbook covers (flat colour blocks, chunky numbered titles)
options.thesis: The report your child needs, set like the textbook every Kenyan family knows.
options.viewport: The homepage as one textbook cover: title block, grade band, a numbered chapter list for how it works.
options.risk: Familiar to the point of homework; children may read the quiz as a test.

options.label: Trading Card Pack
options.lineage: collectible card packs, front portrait and ruled stat back
options.thesis: Your child's results arrive as a pack of career cards to flip and collect.
options.viewport: A dealt fan of career cards with the CTA to open your child's pack.
options.case: Strong on product clarity for results; weaker identification for Kenyan parents than school life.
options.risk: Collecting mechanics can feel like a game shop rather than guidance.

options.label: Tabbed Manual
options.lineage: boxed-software manuals with coloured tab dividers
options.thesis: The assessment as a tabbed manual.
options.viewport: An open manual at the current section tab.
options.case: Parents and children have no relationship with software manuals.
options.kept: One hue per division with the current tab extended, used for quiz progress.
options.risk: Cold and technical for a child.

options.label: Jacquard Brocade
options.viewport: A woven motif built from answers.
options.case: Too abstract for a nine-year-old and too luxurious for the price point.
options.kept: Traceability: every result points to the answer that produced it.

options.label: Ikebana Alcove
options.viewport: One arrangement in an empty alcove.
options.case: No cultural tie to Kenyan families; too quiet to convert.
options.kept: Restraint: one focal move per section.
options.risk: Reads as a spa, not a school product.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: The quiz as a typed conversation.
options.viewport: A transcript with a blinking cursor.
options.case: Hostile to children and parents alike.
options.kept: System states print themselves in plain words instead of chrome.

options.label: One-bit Desktop
options.viewport: Overlapping windows on a gray desktop.
options.case: Drops the brand colours and means nothing to the audience.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean edtech landing page, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Split hero with headline and CTA beside a report preview.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
